commit_scope: Keep app.hati.earth Sheet tracking available by moving continuously polled web health off the deep native-proof API route and onto the Form-native, full-schema bounded health projection.

task_card.goal: Stop the web health proxy from duplicating deep native-runtime proof and starving the API worker that carries Hati Sheet reads.
done_when: The web health proxy calls bounded /api/health/pulse and never calls deep /api/health.
The bounded projection preserves the full HealthResponse payload, including cached file-backed deployed SHA, without running native-carrier or deployment-witness proof.
A failed proxy read does not amplify API strain with a second runtime-telemetry request to the same worker.
The projection is authored in Form, returns verdict 4095 across Go/Rust/TypeScript/fkwu, and is exposed by the native API catalog while Python remains a named compatibility carrier.

The pulse witness preserves intentionally omitted schema and audit proofs as unknown through latency decoration, excludes them from uptime, repair evidence, and cross-organ rollups, and still fails observed compromise or malformed fields.
Focused tests, production web build, local API/web validation, exact-head CI/review, rollout, public verification, and authenticated Hati Sheet-state proof pass.

constraints: Keep deep native and deployment-witness proof available on explicit /api/health verification paths.
Keep the continuous proxy response backward-compatible for current consumers and the release verifier.
Keep Sheet, household, balance, token, nonce, and SSH material out of repository evidence.

evidence_refs: Hostinger run 38099504289 repeatedly proved exact deployed SHA, persistence, native authority, and Hati pages before the web health-proxy phase caused long deep-health stalls followed by public API timeouts and 404 responses.
The bounded route re-registration repair completed successfully before the deeper failure, proving that proxy-induced deep-health pressure was distinct from service registration.
Exact-head review found that the first raw-ping draft narrowed the declared HealthProxyResponse and kept new projection meaning in Python; that draft was replaced rather than defended.
The Form-native bounded-health-projection recipe preserves all HealthResponse fields while setting native carrier and deployment witness outputs to their explicit unobserved values.
The projection returns verdict 4095 across Go, Rust, TypeScript, and fkwu, and the native Coherence Network API catalog serves the same /api/health/pulse route.

Exact-head kernel review moved all database connections off the native liveness route and excluded pulse traffic from its own recent-outcome accounting; Go execution and Rust native route selection pass.

Merged kernel PR #594 at immutable merge commit 7484d12b4f105a25e916517d6ba50078bf0cdbbf refreshes the minute-level recent-outcome cache through /api/ready's existing database connection, so normal readiness traffic can populate pulse output without returning database work to liveness.

The Python compatibility carrier mirrors the Form recipe with explicit unverified schema/audit fields, in-memory recent outcomes, uptime, and revision fields; tests fail if pulse invokes schema, ledger, native-runtime, or deployment-witness proof.

Exact-head parent review found that the existing pulse witness treated intentionally unobserved schema/audit proof as failure; the witness now records those bounded observations as unknown without opening a false silence, while observed compromise still fails.

A second exact-head review proved that display-level unknown was insufficient because ok=True still counted toward uptime and repair receipts; one observed-sample boundary now excludes the unobserved prefix from reconciliation, rollups, uptime, and latency evidence.

Final exact-head review found two downstream erasures of non-observation: slow-response decoration overwrote the marker, and all-organ uptime averaged its zero sentinel. The shared prefix now survives decoration and unobserved-only organs are omitted from the banner rollup.
The web proxy suppresses its secondary runtime-event POST on 5xx responses so failure observation cannot add another request to the already strained API.
No secret, token, nonce, household value, balance, private Sheet URL, or SSH material is present in this evidence.
